title: maximum line length filter
recipe: Split the text into lines, find the length of the longest one, and reject the sample if any line exceeds 200 characters. If it passes, return KEEP and copy the input text exactly, without changing any character.
why_good: Demonstrates a passing maximum-line-length decision while preserving the input byte-for-byte
